title: BUGFIX — /today shows duplicate video IDs in top 3 (ledger has multiple entries per video)
rationale: cmdToday() builds unposted list from publish-ledger.jsonl which has multiple entries per video_id (e.g., video-75ac1293 appears 9x). The filter at line 562 doesn't deduplicate, so the top 3 shows same video multiple times. Fix: add seenVids Set to deduplicate after the initial filter.

tasks.description: In scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-content.ts cmdToday(): after filtering unposted, deduplicate by video_id using a Set before sorting. Add seenVids Set and filter out duplicate video_ids.
